name: Life spaceship 232055ff on elongated triangular tiling 3.3.3.4.4
description: A period-2 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the elongated triangular tiling 3.3.3.4.4, with touching neighbours, 8 to 12 cells, moving one lattice step every 2 generations (c/2). It runs the same way in the 8,192 rules from B3/S23 to B3,5,7,9,10,11,12/S1,2,3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12. It also runs in Life, unchanged, on k3-013 and k3-019. This is probably EricG's 3.3.3.4.4 ship, credited to EricG 2013.
